name: tdd-wf
description: Test-driven feature-build workflow for an unfamiliar codebase: map the repo into a navigable wiki (/to-wiki) and a C4 architecture model (/to-c4), cut the task into vertical walking-skeleton slices each E2E-testable (/to-slices), then drive every slice through /red → /green → /refactor with outside-in TDD, shift-left gating, and atomic feature-scoped commits, and finish with /presubmit (full real gate + a parallel multi-agent grading panel). Stack-agnostic; discovers conventions at runtime.
